I wrote `{"invariant_exists": false}` to the answer file. This comes from reading the code only; I couldn't run anything here.

It isn't an invariant because the suite passes both timezone-less and timezone-aware `time` values. At line 144, `aware_datetime` is built with `dtm.datetime.combine(reference_date, time_object)`, so it gets its timezone from `time_object`.

- **Timezone-less:** calls like `dtm.time(12, 30)` and `dtm.time(6, 15)` produce an `aware_datetime` whose `tzinfo` is `None`. The property holds.
- **Timezone-aware:** calls like `dtm.time(6, 15, tzinfo=UTC)` (test line 25), `dtm.time(9, 45, tzinfo=tz)` (line 33) and `dtm.time(3, 5, tzinfo=time_tz)` (line 115) produce one whose `tzinfo` is set. The property fails.

Since `aware_datetime.tzinfo is None` is true at line 145 on some runs and false on others, it doesn't hold across the suite.
